name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: The connection-speed test now times a real file from each friend instead of a test endpoint that read far too low, so fast friends are no longer capped to 20 Mbps 1080p and 4K titles play in full quality. The library "This server" tab now filters on the server, so it shows all of your own titles with correct paging instead of a few cards or an empty page, and the source tabs no longer hide a friend's episodes on a show's page or miss the first page you open.
